scaffold.title: Web UI scaffold
scaffold.body: The SPA toolchain is wired up: Vite, React, TypeScript (strict), React Router, TanStack Query, TanStack Table, react-i18next, CSS Modules and Vitest. Feature screens land in src/features/<name>/ from G1.2 on.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again, and include the request id if it keeps happening.
errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: The server rejected that input. Check the values and try again.
errors.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted by someone else.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: That already exists. Reload the page to see the current state.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: The server is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.FAILED_PRECONDITION: That action is not allowed in the current state. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ABORTED: That change conflicted with someone else’s. Reload the page and try again.
errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: That value is outside the range the server accepts.
errors.UNIMPLEMENTED: This server version does not support that yet.
errors.INTERNAL: The server hit an internal error. If it keeps happening, report the request id.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The server could not be reached. Check your connection; the page will keep trying.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
